name: Handwriting SVG

mode.description: paths: author-supplied single-stroke <path> children. text: draws an aria-hidden outline copy of the host's own text.

duration.description: Total draw duration, in ms, split across the strokes in proportion to their length.

stagger.description: Delay between each stroke's start, in ms.

fillAfter.description: Fade a solid fill in once the last stroke finishes drawing.

a11y: In paths mode, mount adds role="img" to the host SVG when it is missing and logs a console warning when there is no aria-label, since the drawn strokes carry no text alternative on their own.
In text mode, the original text stays in the DOM as visually hidden real text (.genui-handwriting-svg__sr) and the drawn SVG copy is aria-hidden, so screen readers read the phrase once, not twice.
The drawing plays once, never loops and traps no focus; nothing in the effect is interactive.
Stroke and fill colour contrast against the background is the author's own responsibility.
